name: Soi Taratibea Alayawickrom Ririchak
original_name: ソイ＝タラティベア＝ アラヤウィクロム＝リリチャック
source:
Star Sign: Sagittarius
Elemental Attribute: Wind
Special Attribute: Luck 5/Create 3/Charm 3
Starting Spells: Fire 2/Lightning 6/Quake 2/Ice 2/Holy 5/Healing 3/Call 2/Aging 4/Shield 3
Symbol: A crystal short sword (Level 6)

A strange magic swordsman at the Academy. He has outstanding magical ability.
He's the 7th prince of the southern Kingdom of Shigri.
He has a bad habit of being a bit too prideful about his social status and abilities.
